Type is closely related to Job Type. Different job types support different worker types.

TFJob: Supports Chief, PS, Worker, Evaluator, and GraphLearn.

PyTorchJob: Supports Worker and Master.

XGBoostJob: Supports Worker and Master.
OneFlowJob: Supports Worker and Master.
ElasticBatch: Supports Worker and Master.
RayJob: Supports Head, Worker, and Worker[-xxx].

Master is optional in PyTorchJob, XGBoostJob, OneFlowJob, and ElasticBatch. If Master is not specified, the system automatically designates the first Worker node as Master

parameters.help_zh:
JobSpecs描述任务运行时的各种配置，诸如镜像地址、启动命令、节点资源申明、副本数量等。

DLC任务由不同类型的节点组成，同一类型的节点拥有完全相同的配置，这种配置被称为一个JobSpec。JobSpecs描述所有类型节点的配置，是JobSpec的数组
parameters.name: job_specs

parameters.help_en: The job type. This parameter is case-sensitive. Currently supported job types:
parameters.help_zh:
任务类型，大小写敏感。当前支持的任务类型：
TFJob
PyTorchJob
MPIJob
XGBoostJob
OneFlowJob
ElasticBatchJob
SlurmJob
RayJob
DataJuicerJob
parameters.name: job_type

parameters.help_en: The additional configuration for this node. You can use this parameter to adjust certain behaviors of mounted data sources. For example, if the node has an OSS-type data source mounted, you can set this parameter to `fs.oss.download.thread.concurrency=4,fs.oss.download.queue.size=16` to overwrite the default JindoFS parameter settings
parameters.help_zh: 本任务的额外配置，通过此参数可以调整挂载的数据源的一些行为。如任务有挂载OSS类型的数据源时，可以通过将此参数配置为 `fs.oss.download.thread.concurrency=4,fs.oss.download.queue.size=16` ，覆盖JindoFS的默认参数
parameters.name: options

parameters.help_en: The priority of the job. This is an optional parameter. The default value is 1. Valid values: 1 to 9. Specifically:
parameters.help_zh:
任务的优先级，可选参数，默认值1，参数值的范围是1~9。其中：

1为最低优先级。
9为最高优先级
parameters.name: priority

parameters.help_en: The resource group ID. This is an optional parameter
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID，可选参数。
参数值为空表示提交到公共资源组。
如果当前工作空间已经绑定的资源配额，此处可以指定对应的资源配额ID；如何查询资源配额ID，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2651299.html
parameters.name: resource_id

parameters.help_zh: 调度策略
parameters.name: scheduling_strategy

fields.help_zh: 是否需要挂载全部RDMA网卡
fields.name: allocate_all_rdma_devices

fields.help_en: The user ID associated with the job
fields.name: business_user_id

The command type. Valid values:

fields.help_zh:
命令类型：

shell：填写shell命令。
config：填写DataJuicer的yaml配置

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable resource estimation. When resource estimation is enabled, the execution mode must be distributed, and the command type must be config (DataJuicer YAML configuration)
fields.help_zh: 是否开启资源预估。开启资源预估时，要求运行模式是分布式（distributed），命令行是DataJuicer的yaml配置（config）
fields.name: enable_resource_estimation

fields.help_en:
The execution mode. Valid values:

standalone: single-node.
distributed: distributed
fields.help_zh:
运行模式：

standalone：单节点。
distributed：分布式
fields.name: execution_mode

fields.help_en: The memory capacity limit, in Gi

fields.name: data_juicer_config

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to skip inventory check. Valid values:
true
false
fields.help_zh:
是否跳过库存校验。取值如下：
true
false
fields.name: disable_ecs_stock_check

fields.help_en: 弹性Spot任务最大重启次数
fields.help_zh: 弹性Spot任务最大重启次数
fields.name: elastic_spot_job_max_restart_times

fields.help_en: The CPU affinity setting. This setting is effective only when using general computing subscription resources
fields.help_zh: CPU亲和性设置，仅在使用通用计算预付费资源时该设置有效
fields.name: enable_cpu_affinity

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable fault tolerance monitoring for the job. Valid values:
true
false
fields.help_zh:
允许作业开启容错监控。取值如下：
true
false
fields.name: enable_error_monitoring_in_ai_master

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow OSS append write. Valid values:
true
false
fields.help_zh:
是否允许OSS追加写。取值如下：
true
false
fields.name: enable_oss_append

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to allow the job to use RDMA. Valid values:
true
false
fields.help_zh:
允许作业使用RDMA。取值如下：
true
false
fields.name: enable_rdma

Specifies whether to enable computing power health check for the job. Valid values:
true
false
fields.help_zh:
允许作业开启算力健康检测。取值如下：
true
false

true
false
fields.help_zh:
允许任务使用潮汐资源。取值如下：
true
false
fields.name: enable_tide_resource

fields.help_en: The configuration parameters for fault tolerance monitoring after it is enabled, such as whether to enable log hang-based detection
fields.help_zh: 启用容错监控后，用于指定容错监控的配置参数，比如指定是否启动基于log hang的检测
fields.name: error_monitoring_args

fields.help_en: The retention duration after job completion, in minutes
fields.help_zh: 作业结束后保留的时长（分钟）

fields.help_zh: 作业结束后保留的策略
fields.name: job_reserved_policy

fields.name: provider

fields.help_zh: 作业的超卖资源使用方式（不接受/可接受/只接受）

fields.help_en: The configuration parameters for computing power health check
fields.help_zh: 算力健康检测的配置参数
fields.name: sanity_check_args

parameters.help_en: The additional parameter settings for the job
parameters.help_zh: 作业额外参数配置
parameters.name: settings

parameters.help_en: The success policy for distributed multi-node jobs. Currently only TensorFlow multi-node jobs support this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
分布式多机任务的成功策略，目前只有Tensorflow的多机任务支持。
ChiefWorker：当指定为这个值的时候，只要Chief的pod成功结束，那么就认为整个任务成功结束。
AllWorkers（默认值）：必须是所有的Worker全部成功，才会认为整个任务成功
parameters.name: success_policy

parameters.help_en: The job template ID
parameters.help_zh: 任务模版ID
parameters.name: template_id

parameters.help_en: The job template version
parameters.help_zh: 任务模版版本
parameters.name: template_version

parameters.help_en: The folder name where the third-party Python library (requirements.txt) file is located. Before running the specified UserCommand on each node, PAI-DLC retrieves the requirements.txt file from the specified folder and runs `pip install -r` to install the libraries
parameters.help_zh: Python三方库（requirements.txt）文件所在文件夹名称；每个节点在运行指定的UserCommand之前，PAI-DLC会从指定文件夹取出requirements.txt文件，并调用`pip install -r`安装
parameters.name: thirdparty_lib_dir

parameters.help_en: The list of third-party Python libraries to install
parameters.help_zh: 待安装的Python三方库列表
parameters.name: thirdparty_libs

parameters.help_zh: 任务所有节点的启动命令
parameters.name: user_command

eth1：表示使用用户弹性网卡，通过私有网关访问外部网络。具体配置方法，请参考https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2525343.html

fields.name: extended_cidrs
